title: Covenant Renewal at Shechem

questions.question: Where did Joshua gather all the tribes of Israel for his final address?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:1 (ESV): "Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem..."

questions.question: What famous declaration did Joshua make about his house?
options: As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:15 (ESV): "...But as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord."

questions.question: How did the people respond to Joshua's call to serve?
options: We also will serve the Lord, for he is our God
questions.correctAnswer: We also will serve the Lord, for he is our God
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:18 (ESV): "...Therefore we also will serve the Lord, for he is our God."

questions.question: Who died at the end of the book of Joshua?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:29, 33 mentions the death of Joshua and Eleazar.

questions.question: Whose bones were buried at Shechem?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:32 (ESV): "As for the bones of Joseph... they buried them at Shechem..."

questions.question: Joshua recounts history starting with which patriarch who lived beyond the Euphrates?
options: Terah, the father of Abraham and Nahor
questions.correctAnswer: Terah, the father of Abraham and Nahor
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:2 (ESV): "...Long ago, your fathers lived beyond the Euphrates, Terah, the father of Abraham and of Nahor..."

questions.question: What did Joshua set up under the terebinth/oak?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:26 (ESV): "...and he took a large stone and set it up there under the terebinth..."

questions.question: What did Joshua warn them about God's nature?
options: He is a holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions
questions.correctAnswer: He is a holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:19 (ESV): "...He is a holy God. He is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions or your sins."

questions.question: How old was Joshua when he died?
What did the hornet do?
options: Drove out the two kings of the Amorites before you
questions.correctAnswer: Drove out the two kings of the Amorites before you
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:12 (ESV): "And I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out..."

questions.question: What choice did Joshua present to the people?
options: Choose this day whom you will serve
questions.correctAnswer: Choose this day whom you will serve
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:15 (ESV): "...choose this day whom you will serve..."

questions.question: Serve the Lord in what manner?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:14 (ESV): "Now therefore fear the Lord and serve him in sincerity and in faithfulness."

questions.question: What objects were they told to put away?
options: The foreign gods that are among you
questions.correctAnswer: The foreign gods that are among you
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:23 (ESV): "He said, 'Then put away the foreign gods that are among you...'"

questions.question: Where was Eleazar buried?
options: At Gibeah, the town of Phinehas his son
questions.correctAnswer: At Gibeah, the town of Phinehas his son
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:33 (ESV): "...and they buried him at Gibeah, the town of Phinehas his son..."

questions.question: For how long did Israel serve the Lord?
options: All the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua
questions.correctAnswer: All the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:31 (ESV): "Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua..."

key_verse_text: And if it is evil in your eyes to serve the LORD, choose this day whom you will serve... But as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD. (ESV)
